effects.description: (4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with a Light or Heavy Attack draws essence from the enemy that pools near them for |cffffff5|r seconds. Drawing from the pool heals you for 101-4356 Health, restores 101-4356 Stamina, and increases your damage done by 10% for |cffffff10|r seconds. A pool can only be created once every |cffffff10|r seconds.
